description: Lead segment prioritization model based on conversion readiness and revenue speed

segments.rationale: Direct owner accessibility, booking chatbot provides high daily value.
Clear financial ROI, appointment booking bot increases patient retention.
High seasonal booking pain, quick decision speed during peak weeks.
Steady revenue, appointment booking automation reduces receptionist workload.
Table booking chatbot represents good brand value but lower margin.
Decision speed is slower, committee review blocks fast closes.

prioritization_rules: Filter for Hot Tier leads (score >= 4.0) first.
Prioritize Spa and Nha khoa verticals due to high payment reliability.
Bypass low priority segments in the first 7 days.
